run_report_generation: run the report command to generate a final markdown report for an autoresearch experiment workdir
run_read_failures: run the _read_failures function to collect failure details from engine tree and setup JSON files
run_parse_args: run the _parse_args function to parse command line arguments for the report generation command
review_run_function: review the _run function that orchestrates report generation by reading state, config, analyses, and failures
refactor_read_failures: refactor the _read_failures function to support additional failure source files beyond tree and setup JSON
